name: wisply-local
description: Read-only access to your Wisply memos, transcript excerpts, live transcript and action items from Claude Code on the Mac running Wisply, plus a status line and quote button for live recordings. Talks only to the Wisply app on 127.0.0.1.

wisply_mcp_token.title: Wisply MCP token
wisply_mcp_token.description: Use the read-only connector token from Wisply Settings > Integrations > MCP Server > Connector token (a full-access token also works). Stored in your system's secure credential store. Never paste it into a chat.

live_status.title: Show Wisply recording state
live_status.description: Claude Code only: show Wisply's recording state in the status line and a quote button above the prompt while recording. Checks start after you first use Wisply in a session (/wisply-status, /wisply-quote or a Wisply tool), run every 5 s while recording and every 20 s otherwise, and stop when Wisply stops answering.

quote_words.title: Words per quote
quote_words.description: How many of the most recent live transcript words /wisply-quote and the quote button insert into your prompt (10 to 400).
